About the roster and supported codes

The app reads static Gecko writes into the Sluggers Stat Editor's known NTSC-U stat and chemistry tables. Unsupported instructions are reported. Game logic patches, assembly hooks and conditional codes are not simulated.

Each character or color variant can be drafted once. Each of the 12 Mii colors can be drafted any number of times under a custom name; its gender picks the game slot, which sets batting side (male right, female left). Chemistry is directional; the inspector shows a player's chemistry toward other characters.

Vanilla data and address mapping: Philenarion / Sluggers Stat Editor. Includes 71 playable character variants and 24 optional Mii slots; six unused slots are excluded. Baseline values are the editor's defaults.

Character portraits: Mario Super Sluggers artwork © Nintendo, via sluggers.fyi. Mii slots have no portrait and show their color instead.
